# Hooks

Every public hook is named `joo/<module>/<event>` and listed in the naming registry (a test fails on an unregistered name). Filters and actions are not told apart here; see the source of the module for the signature.

## assets

- `joo/assets/register`
- `joo/assets/runtime_config`
- `joo/assets/inline_script_nonce`

## blocks

- `joo/blocks/register`
- `joo/blocks/data/{slug}`
